subject: General Knowledge
description: Covers UN agencies like FAO, IAEA, WIPO, ICJ, UNEP, UNESCO, and ASEAN.

questions.stem: Where is the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) located?

options.option_text: Rome, Italy
Geneva, Switzerland
Vienna, Austria
Paris, France

questions.explanation: FAO HEADQUARTERS: Located in Rome, Italy. The FAO is a specialized agency of the UN that leads international efforts to defeat hunger and improve nutrition and food security. Founded in October 1945. World Food Programme (WFP) and International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) are also headquartered in Rome. MEMORY AID: "Rome = Romaine Lettuce / Food." PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL, RRB NTPC, State PSCs.

questions.stem: Which of the following organizations is headquartered in Vienna, Austria?

options.option_text: International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)
World Trade Organization (WTO)
International Maritime Organization (IMO)
United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)

questions.explanation:
VIENNA HEADQUARTERS: Vienna, Austria hosts several key international organizations, most notably the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC), and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO). 
- WTO is in Geneva.
- IMO is in London.
- UNEP is in Nairobi. PYQ FREQUENCY: Highly repeated in defense and banking exams.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The headquarters of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) is situated in:

options.option_text: Geneva, Switzerland
New York, USA
Paris, France
The Hague, Netherlands

questions.explanation: GENEVA HEADQUARTERS: Geneva is the global hub for many UN and international bodies. WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization) is one of the 15 specialized agencies of the UN, created in 1967. Other major organizations in Geneva include: WHO, WTO, ILO, WMO (Meteorological), and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CHSL, CGL, Railways.

questions.stem: Where is the headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ), the principal judicial organ of the United Nations?

options.option_text: The Hague, Netherlands
Geneva, Switzerland
New York, USA
Brussels, Belgium

questions.explanation: ICJ HEADQUARTERS: The International Court of Justice is seated at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands. Of the six principal organs of the United Nations, the ICJ is the ONLY one not located in New York City (the others being the General Assembly, Security Council, ECOSOC, Trusteeship Council, and Secretariat). The International Criminal Court (ICC) is also located in The Hague. PYQ FREQUENCY: Very high in UPSC, SSC, CLAT.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The headquarters of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is unique among major UN bodies as it is located in the Global South. Where is it?

options.option_text: Nairobi, Kenya
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
New Delhi, India
Brasilia, Brazil

questions.explanation: UNEP HEADQUARTERS: Located in Nairobi, Kenya. Founded in 1972 after the Stockholm Conference, UNEP is the leading global environmental authority. It was a conscious decision to place a major UN headquarters in a developing country. UN-Habitat is also headquartered in Nairobi. Addis Ababa hosts the African Union. PYQ FREQUENCY: UPSC Prelims, State PSCs, SSC.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which organization is headquartered in Paris, France?

options.option_text: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)
World Tourism Organization (UNWTO)
International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)
Universal Postal Union (UPU)

questions.explanation:
PARIS HEADQUARTERS: UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) is headquartered in Paris, France. Another major organization in Paris is the OECD (Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development) and the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). 
- UNWTO is in Madrid, Spain.
- ICAO is in Montreal, Canada.
- UPU is in Bern, Switzerland. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL, RRB NTPC.

questions.stem: Where is the headquarters of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)?

options.option_text: Jakarta, Indonesia
Manila, Philippines
Bangkok, Thailand
Singapore

questions.explanation: ASEAN HEADQUARTERS: The Secretariat of ASEAN is located in Jakarta, Indonesia. ASEAN was formed in 1967 in Bangkok (Bangkok Declaration) by 5 original members (Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand), but its permanent secretariat was established in Jakarta. The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is headquartered in Manila, Philippines. APEC secretariat is in Singapore. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL, Bank PO, NDA.

questions.stem: The International Labour Organization (ILO), a specialized UN agency mandated to promote social justice and decent work globally, is headquartered in which city?

options.option_text: New York, USA — seat of the UN General Assembly
Geneva, Switzerland — ILO's home city since 1920
Brussels, Belgium — hub of European Union institutions
Vienna, Austria — home to several major UN agencies

questions.explanation: The ILO has been headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland since its founding in 1919 under the Treaty of Versailles. It became a UN specialized agency in 1946. Vienna is a common distractor because it hosts IAEA, UNIDO, and UNODC, but the ILO has always been in Geneva.

questions.stem: The Commonwealth Secretariat, the principal intergovernmental organ serving all 56 member nations of the Commonwealth of Nations, is located at Marlborough House in which city?

options.option_text: Ottawa, Canada — capital of a major Commonwealth realm
Canberra, Australia — capital of the largest Commonwealth realm
London, United Kingdom — Secretariat's seat established in 1965
New Delhi, India — capital of the most populous member state

questions.explanation: The Commonwealth Secretariat has been headquartered at Marlborough House, London since 1965, when it was established as the main intergovernmental body. New Delhi is a common distractor because India is the largest member by population, but the UK, as the founding nation, hosts the Secretariat.

questions.stem: The International Criminal Court (ICC), which prosecutes individuals for war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide, shares its host city with the International Court of Justice (ICJ). Where are both tribunals located?

options.option_text: Brussels, Belgium — headquarters of NATO and the EU Council
Geneva, Switzerland — home to the UN Human Rights Council
The Hague, Netherlands — seat of both the ICC and the ICJ
Luxembourg — seat of the European Court of Justice (ECJ)

questions.explanation: Both the ICC (est. 2002 under the Rome Statute) and the ICJ (the UN's principal judicial organ) are headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Candidates often confuse the two courts: the ICJ settles disputes between states, whereas the ICC prosecutes individuals. Geneva is wrong as it hosts OHCHR, not these courts.

questions.stem: The SAARC Secretariat, which coordinates cooperation among eight South Asian nations and was formally established under the Kathmandu Charter, is located in which capital city?

options.option_text: New Delhi, India — capital of the largest SAARC member state
Kathmandu, Nepal — location of the SAARC Secretariat since 1987
Islamabad, Pakistan — capital of a major founding SAARC member
Colombo, Sri Lanka — island-nation and active SAARC member state

questions.explanation: The SAARC Secretariat has been in Kathmandu, Nepal since 1987, the same year SAARC was formally operationalised. New Delhi is the most frequent wrong answer since India is the dominant economic and geographic power in SAARC, but Nepal was chosen as a neutral smaller member to host the Secretariat.

questions.stem: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), which won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2013 and oversees implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention, is permanently headquartered in which city?

options.option_text: Geneva, Switzerland — home to disarmament conference bodies
Vienna, Austria — seat of the International Atomic Energy Agency
The Hague, Netherlands — OPCW's permanent headquarters since 1997
Brussels, Belgium — headquarters of major NATO and EU institutions

questions.explanation: The OPCW has been headquartered in The Hague since the Chemical Weapons Convention entered into force in 1997. Geneva is the most tempting distractor because it hosts the Conference on Disarmament (CD) and many arms-control dialogues, but the OPCW is specifically in The Hague, which also hosts the ICC and ICJ.

questions.stem: The African Union Commission — the administrative secretariat of the 55-member continental bloc — is permanently headquartered in the same city where the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) held its founding summit in 1963. Identify that city.

options.option_text: Cairo, Egypt — political and cultural capital of North Africa
Lagos, Nigeria — the most populous urban centre on the continent
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia — AU Commission headquarters since the OAU era
Johannesburg, South Africa — the continent's largest financial hub

questions.explanation: Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia, hosted the OAU founding summit in May 1963 and has remained the seat of African continental governance ever since. When the AU replaced the OAU in 2002, it retained Addis Ababa as its headquarters. Lagos and Johannesburg are frequent distractors because of their economic prominence, but neither hosts the AU.

questions.stem: The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS), established under UNCLOS to adjudicate maritime boundary disputes and seabed-resource conflicts, is headquartered in which European city — surprising many who assume it sits alongside the ICJ?

options.option_text: The Hague, Netherlands — seat of the ICJ and ICC international courts
Hamburg, Germany — location of the ITLOS headquarters since 1996
Geneva, Switzerland — home to numerous UN specialized agencies
Rotterdam, Netherlands — Europe's largest seaport and maritime hub

questions.explanation: ITLOS has been headquartered in Hamburg, Germany since 1996, when UNCLOS's dispute-settlement provisions came into force. The Hague is the overwhelmingly common wrong answer because it hosts the ICJ and ICC; however, Germany secured ITLOS during UNCLOS negotiations. Rotterdam is a trap for those who reason 'maritime = major port city.'
